typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		MEMBERNUMBER as string,
		WMDS_SEQ_NO as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT /*+ parallel (SBSB, 4) */ DISTINCT SBSB.SBSB_ID MEMBERNUMBER FROM FACETS.CMC_MEWM_ME_MSG MEWM     INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME            ON (MEME.MEME_CK = MEWM.MEME_CK)      INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB            ON (SBSB.SBSB_CK = MEME.SBSB_CK) WHERE MEWM.WMDS_SEQ_NO = 39 AND MEWM.SYS_LAST_UPD_DTM > SYSDATE - 30',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> FACETSLegacyMembers
FACETSLegacyMembers derive(MEMBERNUMBER = toString(MEMBERNUMBER) + '00') ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn derive(MEMBERNUMBER = MEMBERNUMBER) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount
PlaceHolderRowCount sink(input(
		WMDS_SEQ_NO as string,
		Legacy_stMemberNumber as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		WMDS_SEQ_NO,
		Legacy_stMemberNumber = MEMBERNUMBER)) ~> PDSLegacyStaging
